summary: Iteration 5: tested per-coin pause/resume, closed-trade CSV export + coin filter, hurdle tuner, latency benchmark run/status/verdict, and telemetry regressions. Backend pytest: 17/17 pass in re-run (one flaky failure on TestBenchmark::test_status_has_result during the very first xdist parallel invocation while the initial 30s benchmark result was still transitioning; re-run passed). Benchmark ran successfully 30s BTC/ETH/SOL with real Binance/CoinSwitch/CoinDCX WS. Frontend: pause toggle, closed-trades filter, CSV href, hurdle-tuner panel, benchmark panel + run + progress, and verdict card all render and mostly work. Discovered a HIGH priority frontend bug: the /api/status polling interval (1.5s) resets cfgDraft to server config every tick, so users cannot edit Signal & Risk Parameters (entry_fee, exit_fee, slippage, extra hurdle, timeout, stop loss) — anything typed reverts within ~1-1.5s. This breaks the hurdle-tuner draft flow (spec says extra=0 should give DRAFT 0.130%; observed the input reverts to 0.02 within a second and the badge stays at 0.150%). Verdict-card fee inputs (verdict-fee-coinswitch-input / coindcx) use local state and are NOT affected — the coindcx fee edit to 0.02 correctly updated the verdict row hurdle to 0.09%. Also mobile 390px viewport has ~224px horizontal overflow (worse than iter4's 41px), likely from BenchmarkPanel/VerdictCard fixed widths. Bot left RUNNING, PAPER mode, no coins paused. Zero real Telegram messages sent this iteration.

minor.issue: Flaky in the very first parallel pytest run — TestBenchmark::test_status_has_result asserted divergence_bps.p50 on the current /result while another concurrent test may have been ending. Re-running the same test in isolation passed. Suggest guarding /benchmark/run with an idle-check race and ensuring the persisted last_result.json is atomic (write to .tmp then rename).

ui_bugs.issue: The polling interval created in useEffect(pull, 1500, []) captures the initial pull closure where cfgDraft is null; every tick therefore runs setCfgDraft(cfg.data), overwriting whatever the user typed. Result: extra-hurdle input reverts to 0.02 within ~1.5s of typing and DRAFT badge stays at 0.150% instead of 0.130%. All 6 config inputs are affected (entry/exit fee, slippage, extra hurdle, timeout, stop loss). Save Settings still works because the values in-flight during the click may be captured, but the interactive draft-tuner UX is broken.

Add min-w-0 / overflow-x-hidden on outer sections or make VerdictCard fee grid stack on <sm.

action_items: HIGH: Fix cfgDraft-reset bug. Options: (a) drop the `if (!cfgDraft)` and only initialize cfgDraft on first successful fetch via a ref, (b) move the interval into useEffect with correct deps or use useRef to hold the latest cfgDraft, (c) split config polling into a separate effect that only sets cfgDraft when it's null via a functional setter: `setCfgDraft(prev => prev || cfg.data)`. Approach (c) is a 1-line fix.

MEDIUM: Fix mobile 390px overflow (~224px). Investigate BenchmarkPanel (3-column duration+run row and 3-col fee-inputs grid inside VerdictCard) — likely a fixed-width children on <sm. Add flex-wrap / grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 pattern and min-w-0 on children.
LOW: Persist benchmark last_result.json atomically (write-then-rename) to avoid rare partial reads during the transition when a new run finishes just as another test reads status.
LOW: Emergent-tooling injects <span> children into <option> elements causing a React hydration console error. Not a real app bug but pollutes console — Emergent instrumentation team.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js line 373-378: `useEffect(() => { pull(); const id=setInterval(pull, 1500); return...}, [])` — pull captured closure includes cfgDraft state. The empty-deps interval will never see updated cfgDraft, so the `if (!cfgDraft) setCfgDraft(cfg.data)` guard is effectively ALWAYS TRUE inside the interval → cfgDraft is reset on every 1.5s tick, blocking all user edits to config inputs. Change to `setCfgDraft(prev => prev || cfg.data)` to fix.
App.js line 442: hurdle-simulate effect depends on draftHurdle which is derived from cfgDraft — the bug above prevents this from ever changing.
BENCH state is process-global with an in-memory task; if server reboots mid-run, last_result.json won't be updated. Consider persisting `running` state or clearing it on startup.

rca of the issue: cfgDraft reset RCA: Dashboard.pull is defined inline in the component body every render. useEffect with empty deps creates the setInterval once with the FIRST render's pull closure. That closure references cfgDraft (initial value = null), so `if (!cfgDraft) setCfgDraft(cfg.data)` evaluates as `if (!null) …` on every 1.5s tick, unconditionally overwriting cfgDraft with the server value. This clobbers whatever the user typed. Reproduction: open the dashboard, focus [data-testid=config-hurdle-gate-input], type '0', observe input reverts to '0.02' within ~1.5s. Fix: use functional setter `setCfgDraft(prev => prev || cfg.data)` OR store cfgDraft in a ref-guarded init OR move the interval into an effect that re-runs on cfgDraft changes. One-line fix at App.js:369 recommended.
